summary: Frontend testing for Phase 23-24 refinements (axios refactor, MC split, engine comparison strip, shareable scenario links). All 6 requested test items pass. 12/12 tabs render, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Planner.jsx exitShared() forces a full page reload via window.location.href — works but is heavier than needed; a client-side history.pushState + state reset would be smoother, but not blocking.
Scenarios.jsx enableShare(): clipboard write is optional-chained AND wrapped in .catch(()=>{}); good defensive behavior for headless/insecure contexts. Toast still fires regardless — correct.

ShareLinkRow: URL span uses truncate with title=url — accessible & copyable via right-click; token extraction works via title attr (regression: raw textContent picks up Copy button label; consumers should read the title attribute, which they do).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_share_* scenario during test; cleaned up via del button after revoke.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified end-to-end: (1) All 12 tabs render with no console errors, (2) axios refactor OK — scenario save/list/delete/share/unshare all work (X-Session-Token still attaches, since save+revoke+delete succeeded), (3) MC Run Simulation renders all cards (mc-gauge-card, mc-compare-card, mc-seq-card, mc-fan-card, mc-hist-card, mc-engine-info) and both nominal/real toggles present, (4) Engine comparison: mc-compare-run produced mc-engine-compare with mc-compare-lognormal (97.2%), mc-compare-historical (98.6%), mc-engine-compare-delta='Historical +1.4 pts' in <60s, (5) Share flow: save->share->share-url-{id} row appears with token (22 chars, base64url), Copy button flips to 'Copied', share URL opens in shared-view-banner with tab-inputs & tab-scenarios hidden, exit-shared-view returns to normal, unshare-{id} removes share-url row, (6) Invalid share token (32 x's) shows shared-view-error banner and default scenario loads with tab-inputs+tab-scenarios visible. Minor gotcha for future automation: when reading share URL from DOM, use the span[title] attribute — reading textContent of the share-url row concatenates the adjacent 'Copy' button label onto the token.
